newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SASOL SIGNS OIL MEMORANDUM WITH MOZAMBIQUE.
newsitem.headline: SASOL SIGNS OIL MEMORANDUM WITH MOZAMBIQUE.

text.p: Sasol Petroleum International (SPI), the crude oil and gas exploration and production unit of South Africa's Sasol Ltd, said on Thursday it had signed a production rights memorandum of understanding with Mozambique's state oil company.

In terms of the memorandum with Empresa Nacional de Hidrocarbonetos de Mocambique (ENH), SPI acquires the rights to negotiate a production sharing agreement with ENH over the Mazenga block onshore Mozambique. Negotiations on this agreement will start shortly, Sasol said in a statement.
The Mazenga block is about 250 km north of Maputo and comprises some 45,000 square km in the Inhambane and Gaza provinces.
SPI, which has established an office in Maputo, holds 100 percent of the interest in the block and will also act as the operator.
The move builds up SPI's interests in Africa and Southern Africa in particular. It recently acquired a 20 percent interest in Blocks 17 and 18 offshore South Africa, north of Durban.
